06/13.09.2024  Heard the parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 174/2018 arising out of Mango P.S. Case No. 13 of 2018, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)(i) and 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of Learned Additional Session Judge-V-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Act at Jamshedpur.

entities.text: Court of Learned Additional Session Judge-V-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Act at Jamshedpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The daughter of the informant was employed by one Nanak Chand Seth.
It is alleged that she established physical relationship with an electrician who was neighbor of Nanak Chand Seth.

It is further alleged that she was also raped by several accused persons and the F.I.R. was registered against three persons namely Shiv Kumar Mahto (Electrician), Indrapal Saini and one gardener Sahara City namely Srikant.

During the trial of this case, name of twenty persons including this petitioner has surfaced that they had also raped the victim.
The matter was investigated by the C.I.D., Jharkhand.

After investigation,
final form was submitted in this case.
During the course of trial, the prosecutrix again reiterated the name of these persons including the petitioner.
Thereafter, the petitioner and other persons were made accused under Section 319 of the Cr.P.C.

It appears that one of the accused namely Imdad Ansari who was also accused under Section 319 of the Cr.P.C., has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court vide A.B.A. No. 2243 of 2024 and the case of the petitioner tands on similar footing.
In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the learned court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender, shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Learned Additional Session Judge-V-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Act at Jamshedpur in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 174/2018 arising out of Mango P.S. Case No. 13 of 2018, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr. P.C. (Ambuj Nath, J.) Rahul/-
